name: Drought recurrence
description: Return period or scenario frequency for a precisely defined drought event and basin.

name: Reservoir inflows
description: Observed or assumed inflow volume or normalized index for a named reservoir system and period.

name: Snowpack assumption
description: Snow-water-equivalent index as a percentage of normal for a named basin and bulletin date.

name: Copper price
description: Specified copper benchmark price, with benchmark, market, frequency and real or nominal price basis retained in source metadata.

name: Critical mineral demand
description: Demand for a named mineral under a named scenario, expressed in physical units or an index; mineral and end use are required dimensions.

name: Mid-Columbia electricity price assumption
description: Average Mid-Columbia wholesale electricity price assumption used by the named decision maker.

name: Japan LNG import price proxy
description: World Bank monthly Japan LNG import price series. This is a public proxy and is not Platts JKM.

name: LNG price (JKM)
description: Platts Japan Korea Marker price or a clearly labelled public proxy; proprietary JKM values must not be republished without suitable rights.

name: AECO natural gas price
description: Specified AECO or Alberta NIT benchmark, with product, delivery period and administrator retained in metadata.

name: Henry Hub natural gas price
description: Henry Hub natural gas spot price for the stated reference period.

name: Sumas natural-gas price assumption
description: Average Sumas natural-gas price assumption used by the named decision maker.

name: Brent oil price
description: Europe Brent spot price.

name: WTI oil price
description: Cushing, Oklahoma West Texas Intermediate spot price.

name: Annual electricity demand
description: Annual electrical energy demand for a defined system, customer scope and weather-treatment basis.

name: Electricity load growth rate
description: Compound annual growth rate in annual electricity demand over the stated forecast interval.

name: Utility electricity demand forecast
description: Electricity demand or sales forecast for the named utility, service territory, scenario, target period and vintage.

name: Utility electricity sales
description: Electricity sales for the named utility and service territory, retaining quarterly, year-to-date or annual basis in metadata.

name: Utility natural-gas sales
description: Natural-gas sales for the named utility and service territory, retaining quarterly, year-to-date or annual basis in metadata.

name: Utility peak-demand forecast
description: Peak-demand forecast for the named utility, service territory, scenario, target period and vintage.

name: Utility peak demand
description: Peak system demand for the named utility, service territory, measurement interval and period.

name: Construction inflation
description: Year-over-year percentage change in the Statistics Canada Building Construction Price Index for aggregate non-residential construction in Vancouver.

name: Vancouver non-residential construction price index
description: Quarterly aggregate non-residential building construction price index for Vancouver.

name: All-items CPI index
description: Monthly all-items Consumer Price Index for British Columbia.

name: Inflation
description: Year-over-year percentage change in the all-items Consumer Price Index for British Columbia.

name: Employment growth
description: Percentage change in seasonally adjusted employment from the same month one year earlier.

name: Employment
description: Seasonally adjusted number of employed persons aged 15 years and over in British Columbia, after applying the Statistics Canada scalar factor.

name: CAD per USD exchange rate
description: Daily average Canadian-dollar value of one United States dollar.

name: Real exports growth
description: Annual percentage change in real exports of goods and services for the stated geography and forecast vintage.

name: Household growth
description: Percentage change in the estimated or projected number of private households from the preceding year.

name: Households
description: Estimated or projected number of private households in British Columbia; collective dwellings excluded.

name: Housing completions in centres of 10,000 and over
description: Monthly housing completions in British Columbia population centres of 10,000 and over; not a full provincial total.

name: Annual housing starts
description: Observed or forecast total housing starts over a calendar year in British Columbia; distinct from monthly SAAR measures.

name: Housing starts growth (SAAR)
description: Percentage change in British Columbia total housing starts at a seasonally adjusted annual rate from the same month one year earlier.

name: Housing starts (SAAR)
description: CMHC housing starts in British Columbia, seasonally adjusted at an annual rate, for the reference month.

name: Housing units under construction in centres of 10,000 and over
description: Month-end housing units under construction in British Columbia population centres of 10,000 and over; not a full provincial total.

name: Real imports growth
description: Annual percentage change in real imports of goods and services for the stated geography and forecast vintage.

name: Government of Canada 10-year benchmark yield
description: Daily yield on the Government of Canada 10-year benchmark bond.

name: Bank of Canada target overnight rate
description: Bank of Canada target for the overnight rate on the reference date.

name: Labour force growth
description: Percentage change in the seasonally adjusted labour force from the same month one year earlier.

name: Labour force
description: Seasonally adjusted number of persons aged 15 years and over in the labour force in British Columbia, after applying the Statistics Canada scalar factor.

name: Labour force participation rate
description: Labour force participation rate for the stated geography, age and sex scope, period, source and forecast vintage.

name: Nominal GDP growth
description: Annual percentage change in nominal gross domestic product for the stated geography and forecast vintage.

name: Population growth
description: Percentage change in the estimated resident population of British Columbia from the same reference period one year earlier.

name: Population
description: Estimated resident population of British Columbia at the reference date.

name: Labour productivity growth
description: Annual percentage change in labour productivity under the stated definition, source and scenario.

name: Real GDP growth
description: Annual percentage change in real gross domestic product for British Columbia.

name: Retail sales growth
description: Annual percentage change in nominal retail sales for the stated geography and forecast vintage.

name: Unemployment rate
description: Unemployment rate for the stated geography, population scope, period, source and forecast vintage.

name: Building electrification rate
description: Annual share of the specified building stock converting a named end use from fossil fuel to electricity.

name: Battery-electric vehicle stock
description: Registered battery-electric vehicle stock in B.C. under the configured ICBC geography and vehicle-class scope.

name: Battery-electric vehicle stock growth
description: Annual percentage growth in registered B.C. battery-electric vehicle stock under a consistent ICBC scope.

name: Plug-in hybrid vehicle stock
description: Registered plug-in hybrid vehicle stock in B.C. under the configured ICBC geography and vehicle-class scope.

name: Plug-in hybrid vehicle stock growth
description: Annual percentage growth in registered B.C. plug-in hybrid vehicle stock under a consistent ICBC scope.

name: EV stock
description: Registered in-use light-duty or total electric vehicles, with vehicle and powertrain scope specified.

name: EV stock growth
description: Year-over-year percentage change in the defined electric-vehicle stock.

name: Heat pump installed cost
description: Installed cost for a defined heat-pump type and building archetype, with rebate, tax, electrical-upgrade and dollar-year treatment specified.

name: Residential electric heating-system stock
description: NRCan estimate of electric residential heating systems in British Columbia, excluding the separately identified heat-pump category.

name: Residential heat-pump share
description: NRCan estimate of heat pumps as a share of residential heating-system stock in British Columbia.

name: Residential heat-pump heating-system stock
description: NRCan estimate of residential heat-pump heating systems in British Columbia.

name: Residential natural-gas heating-system stock
description: Combined NRCan estimate of medium- and high-efficiency natural-gas residential heating systems in British Columbia.

name: B.C. gross reported natural-gas production
description: Monthly sum of gross reported gas production in the BCER bulk archive; not equivalent to marketable production.

name: B.C. marketable natural-gas production
description: Monthly British Columbia marketable natural-gas production published by the Canada Energy Regulator.

name: Allowed return on equity
description: Regulator-approved return on equity for a named utility and decision context.

name: Cost of debt
description: Embedded, forecast or allowed cost of debt, with issuer, regulatory treatment and period specified. Retain entity, approval status, decision context and filing vintage.

name: Cost of equity
description: Forecast or allowed return on equity, with methodology, capital structure and period specified. Retain entity, approval status, decision context and filing vintage.

name: Deemed common-equity share
description: Regulator-approved deemed common-equity share for a named utility and decision context.

name: Discount rate
description: Legacy generic discount-rate variable retained for compatibility. New records should use social, utility-regulatory or pension discount-rate variables and preserve the named decision context.

name: Long-term interest-rate assumption
description: Long-term Canadian interest-rate assumption used in a named public-sector or utility decision context.

name: Pension and post-employment-benefit discount rate
description: Accounting discount-rate assumption used for pension or other post-employment-benefit expense; context must be retained and it must not be treated as a project discount rate.

name: Short-term interest-rate assumption
description: Short-term Canadian interest-rate assumption used in a named public-sector or utility decision context.

name: Social discount rate
description: Real social discount rate prescribed or recommended for a named public policy or benefit-cost decision context. This is a non-temporal parameter and must retain its publication, effective and decision context.

name: Utility regulatory discount rate
description: Discount rate used for a named utility regulatory calculation. This is a non-temporal parameter; it must not be confused with allowed ROE, WACC, cost of debt or pension discount rates.

name: WACC
description: Nominal or real weighted average cost of capital, before or after tax as explicitly identified. Retain entity, approval status, decision context and filing vintage.

name: AI compute growth
description: Annual growth in a specified measure of AI training or inference compute, with scope and denominator retained.

name: Data centre power intensity
description: Electrical demand per defined unit of data-centre capacity or floor area; denominator and load convention are required.

name: Data centre realization rate
description: Derived probability that a data-centre proposal at a defined development stage reaches construction or commercial operation within a stated time horizon.

name: LNG realization rate
description: Derived probability that a project at a defined development stage reaches a defined realized stage within a stated time horizon.

name: Mining realization rate
description: Derived probability that a mining project at a defined development stage reaches construction or commercial operation within a stated time horizon.

name: Construction lead times
description: Elapsed time between defined project milestones for a named infrastructure class.

name: Transformer lead times
description: Elapsed time from order to delivery for a specified transformer class and procurement market.

name: ELCC assumption
description: Effective load-carrying capability as a share of nameplate capacity for a defined resource, duration, penetration level, system and target year.

name: Electricity import cost
description: Observed or assumed electricity import cost, including market, delivery point, currency and price basis.

name: Canadian electricity export value
description: Monthly value of international electricity exports from Canada, including capacity charges where reported.

name: Canadian electricity exports
description: Monthly international electricity exports from Canada reported by the Canada Energy Regulator.

name: Canadian electricity import value
description: Monthly value of international electricity imports to Canada, including capacity charges where reported.

name: Canadian electricity imports
description: Monthly international electricity imports to Canada reported by the Canada Energy Regulator.

name: Western Canada electricity export price
description: CER monthly weighted-average international electricity export price for the western region, which includes B.C., Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba.

name: Western Canada electricity import price
description: CER monthly weighted-average international electricity import price for the western region, which includes B.C., Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Manitoba.

name: Import energy availability
description: Energy available for import over a defined period and under a named market, hydrological or reliability condition.

name: Reserve margin
description: Planning reserve margin for a defined system, season, planning year and capacity-accreditation convention.

name: Battery cost curve
description: Installed battery-system cost for a defined chemistry, duration, power/energy basis, scenario, target year and dollar year.

name: Hydrogen cost curve
description: Levelized hydrogen production cost for a defined production pathway, electricity price, utilization, scenario, region and dollar year.

name: Solar cost curve
description: Capital cost for a defined solar technology, scale, scenario, target year, region and dollar year.

name: Wind cost curve
description: Capital cost for a defined wind technology, resource class, scenario, target year, region and dollar year.

name: Utility capacity gap
description: Forecast dependable-capacity requirement or supply gap for the named utility, scenario, target period and vintage.

name: Utility actual capital expenditure
description: Actual capital expenditure or property, plant and equipment additions for the named utility and stated reporting basis.

name: Utility capital expenditure forecast
description: Forecast capital expenditure for the named utility, target period and filing vintage.

name: Utility customer count
description: Actual or forecast customer count for the named utility and service territory.

name: Utility customer growth
description: Actual or forecast annual customer-count growth for the named utility and service territory.

name: Utility domestic generation
description: Electricity generated by the named utility within the stated service or reporting scope.

name: Utility demand-side management savings
description: Actual or forecast annual energy savings attributed to utility demand-side management.

name: Incremental electricity load from fuel switching
description: Incremental electricity demand attributed to a named fuel-switching or electrification driver, scenario, target year and forecast vintage.

name: Utility energy supply gap
description: Forecast firm-energy requirement or supply gap for the named utility, scenario, target period and vintage.

name: Independent power and long-term purchases
description: Electricity purchased from independent power producers and long-term contracts by the named utility.

name: Line losses and system use
description: Electricity attributed to line losses and internal system use for the named utility.

name: Utility system loss-rate assumption
description: Electricity or gas system loss-rate assumption used by the named utility in the stated planning or rate context.

name: Utility market purchases
description: Electricity market purchases for the named utility and stated period.

name: Utility natural-gas cost
description: Natural-gas commodity, transport or storage cost for the named gas utility and stated reporting period, with scope retained in metadata.

name: Utility power-purchase cost
description: Power-purchase cost for the named electric utility and stated reporting period.

name: Utility rate base
description: Actual, approved or forecast average rate base for the named regulated utility.

name: Utility rate change
description: Proposed, interim or approved utility rate change for the named utility, service and effective period.

name: Utility system exports
description: Electricity exported by the named utility in the stated period and forecast vintage.

name: Utility system imports
description: Electricity imports assumed or observed for the named utility.

name: Thermal and other generation
description: Thermal and other electricity generation for the named utility.

name: Total utility load and system exports
description: Domestic sales, system exports, line losses and system use for the named utility.

name: Utility electricity trade income
description: Actual or forecast trade income for the named utility and reporting period.

name: System water inflows relative to average
description: Forecast or observed water inflows for the named hydroelectric utility as a percentage of its planning average.
